alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 21 at 6:21AM CST until November 21 at 10:00AM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility as low as one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Counties to the east of the I-35 corridor into the Coastal
Plains.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM CST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
